name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (LPG)
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to women from below-poverty-line households.
eligibility: Women (18+) from BPL households as per SECC criteria.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection; cheaper cooking fuel; health benefits.
application_steps: Visit pmuy.gov.in or nearest LPG distributor.
office_locator_info: Refer to official portal / nearest office
ai_summary: PM Ujjwala Yojana gives BPL women deposit-free LPG connections for clean cooking fuel.
ai_explanation: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to women from below-poverty-line households.
